featured_reviews.review_text:
INOX at Thakur Mall in Dahisar is a popular entertainment hub for residents in the Dahisar and Mira Road areas. Located on the 3rd floor of the mall, it is known for being a well-maintained multiplex that offers a premium cinematic experience at relatively competitive prices compared to other major malls in Mumbai.
Screens: The multiplex typically operates 4 screens, featuring both 2D and 3D projection technology.
​Seating: Options range from standard comfortable seating to luxury recliners (Gold Class) for a more relaxed experience.
​Audio/Visual: Equipped with high-quality sound systems, including Dolby Atmos in select halls, and large screens with high-definition picture quality.
​Accessibility: The cinema is equipped with wheelchair facilities and elevator access.
Refreshments: There is a dedicated F&B counter inside INOX serving classic movie snacks like popcorn, nachos, and sandwiches.
​Food Court: Thakur Mall itself has a multi-cuisine food court on the lower floors, offering a wider variety of dining options after the movie.
​Gaming Zone: There is a gaming area located within the mall, making it a good spot for families and children.
If you're visiting on a weekend, it's advisable to book tickets in advance via apps like BookMyShow, as it is a major landmark and can get quite crowded for blockbuster releases.
Safety system is very nice handle nicely .

Showtime? More like “suggested time.” I’ve been here multiple times, and without fail, every single show starts 20–30 minutes late. Honestly, you could walk in 20 minutes after the scheduled time and still comfortably sit through a full ad marathon before the movie even begins.

At this point, missing a scene here is nearly impossible—not because of great service, but because punctuality clearly isn’t part of the experience.

It’s hard to tell whether the staff is just taking it easy or the management has created some magical, impossible turnaround schedule between shows. Either way, the result is the same: frustration.

A 2-hour movie somehow turns into a 3-hour commitment. Impressive… just not in the way you’d want.

Would not recommend if you value your time.

featured_reviews.name: Bijay Bera
featured_reviews.review_text:
1. Shopping Experience
The mall offers a mix of value-for-money national brands and local retailers. It isn’t as "luxury-focused" as malls in South Mumbai, but it covers all essentials.
* Fashion: You’ll find popular anchors like Max Fashion, Pantaloons, and Reliance Trends. It’s excellent for family shopping, particularly for ethnic wear and kids' clothing.
* Daily Needs: Previously home to Big Bazaar, the mall continues to host large format retail for groceries and household goods (now largely under the Reliance umbrella).
* Electronics: Reliance Digital and Digi1 are the main hubs here for appliances and gadgets.
2. Entertainment (The Biggest Draw)
For most locals, Maxus Mall is synonymous with its 6-screen multiplex and gaming zones.
* Maxus Cinemas: Occupying the 3rd floor, this is the most popular cinema in the area. It features various seating tiers, including "Gold Class" and "Director’s Lounge." It is praised for its sound quality (Atmos) and relatively affordable ticket prices compared to city multiplexes.
* Fun Zone & Gaming: There is a large gaming area featuring arcade games, bowling, and VR experiences. It is a major attraction for teenagers and families with young children.
3. Food & Dining
The mall has a massive 100,000 sq. ft. food court area on the 2nd floor, though the variety of "fine dining" is limited compared to fast food.
* Food Court: Offers everything from Dosas (Shreeji Food Court) to North Indian thalis and Chinese. It is generally budget-friendly, with meals for two costing around ₹300–₹600.
* Standalones: McDonald’s (near the entrance) and Not Just Parathas are consistent favorites.
* Note: During weekends, the food court can get extremely loud and crowded, making it difficult to find seating.
4. Infrastructure & Facilities
* Parking: The mall features two-level basement parking. While spacious, it can get chaotic on Saturday and Sunday evenings. Parking fees are typically around ₹60.
* Accessibility: The mall is equipped with elevators and ramps, making it wheelchair accessible.
* Events: It is a central spot for local events, celebrity visits for movie promotions, and festive décor during Diwali and Christmas.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Movie Time is just a 10-minute walk from the Dahisar Metro Station, but finding it was a bit of a struggle since there were no signs outside to guide us. Unlike most theatres, there’s no clear entry point, which made things confusing.

The lift situation wasn’t great either—there’s only one, and it barely fits five people, so getting in and out felt like a waiting game. Inside, there’s just one screen, and honestly, the theatre felt more like a small pod. The viewing experience was okay, but the sound quality could have been way better.

Now, let’s talk about the seats—definitely not the most comfortable. Sitting through a long movie was a bit of a task. On the plus side, the food area was clean, but the prices? Almost as high as PVR, which felt a bit much for the overall experience.

One good thing—they have free underground parking for both bikes and cars, which is a rare win in Mumbai!

Overall, if you’re nearby and just want to catch a movie, it works. But if you’re looking for a top-tier cinema experience, this might not be the best pick.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I visited INOX at Raghuleela Mega Mall, Kandivali, and overall it was a pleasant movie-watching experience. The theatre is conveniently located inside the mall and easy to reach by public transport as well as private vehicles. Entry and security checks were smooth, and the overall crowd management felt organized. Booking tickets online made the process quick and hassle-free.
Inside the auditorium, the seating was comfortable and well spaced, allowing for a relaxed viewing experience. The screen quality was sharp, and the sound system was clear and immersive, which enhanced the impact of the movie. The air-conditioning was well balanced and added to the comfort throughout the show. Cleanliness inside the hall and common areas was maintained properly.
The food and beverage counter offered the usual INOX snacks like popcorn, nachos, and soft drinks. While the prices were slightly on the higher side, the quality and taste were decent. Staff members were polite and helpful whenever assistance was needed.
Overall, INOX Raghuleela Mall Kandivali is a good option for movie lovers looking for comfort, good audio-visual quality, and a reliable cinema experience. It’s a suitable place for family outings, friends, or solo movie plans.

featured_reviews.name: Suraj Deosarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the INOX multiplex at Raghuleela Mega Mall in Kandivali and had a really pleasant experience overall. The location is quite convenient, especially with the mall offering ample parking and access to food courts and shopping options. As for the multiplex itself, it was clean, well-maintained, and the ambiance was quite inviting.

The staff at INOX were courteous and helpful, right from the ticket counter to the ushers inside the theater. The seating was comfortable, with good legroom and clear visibility from every angle. The sound and picture quality were up to the mark, giving a great cinematic experience. I especially liked the recliner section, which was a bit more expensive but definitely worth it for long movies.

The only reason I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5 is because the food prices at the snack counter are on the higher side, which is typical for multiplexes but still feels excessive. Also, during peak hours, the entry and exit process can feel a bit rushed and crowded.

Overall, INOX Raghuleela is a great place to watch movies with friends or family. I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good movie-going experience in Kandivali.

featured_reviews.name: TripperHD Vlogs
featured_reviews.review_text:
INOX at Raghuleela Mega Mall in Kandivali West is a popular multiplex cinema located on the second floor of the mall. It offers a convenient and modern movie-watching experience for the residents and visitors of Kandivali and surrounding areas. The multiplex features multiple screens, including 3D-enabled auditoriums with silver screens, providing immersive cinematic experiences. With a total seating capacity of 1275 across its four auditoriums, it can accommodate a significant number of moviegoers.

Beyond just movie screenings, INOX Raghuleela Mega Mall also provides food and beverage options for patrons to enjoy during their visit. The cinema is wheelchair-friendly, ensuring accessibility for all. Located within the bustling Raghuleela Mega Mall, visitors can easily combine a movie outing with shopping, dining, and other entertainment options available in the mall. Its strategic location near Poisar Bus Depot and off S.V. Road makes it easily accessible by various modes of transport.
